{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-6n0q","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.7.1: Duplicate ANNOUNCE_TYPE / MAX_ANNOUNCE_HOPS constants between lichen-core and lichen-rpl","description":"## Problem

`ANNOUNCE_TYPE` (`0x01`) and `MAX_ANNOUNCE_HOPS` (`15`) are defined in two places:

1. `rust/lichen-core/src/announce.rs:4-6` (canonical source)
2. `rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:927-929` (newly introduced duplicate)

Additionally, `lichen-core/src/constants.rs:50` defines `ANNOUNCE_TYPE_BYTE = 0x01` — three names for the same constant in the same crate.

## Risk

If one instance is changed without updating the other, the two modules will have diverging values, causing hard-to-debug protocol mismatches at the RPL/announce boundary. `AnnounceState` in routing.rs is gated behind `#[cfg(feature = "std")]` and currently only tested in isolation, but once wired into production message handling the mismatch would be silent.

## Fix

In `routing.rs`, remove the duplicate `pub const` declarations and import from `lichen_core::announce::{ANNOUNCE_TYPE, MAX_ANNOUNCE_HOPS}`. The `lichen-core` announce module is the single source of truth for the announce wire format constants.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T16:52:43.575490723Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T16:52:43.575490723Z"}
